value: This event study presents observed market patterns around Maui County Bill 9 milestones. Residency uses current fullownr mailing addresses as a proxy for owners — not historical buyer residency at each sale. Price metrics use arm's-length fee conveyances above $10,000. Correlation does not establish causation; external factors include mortgage rates, insurance costs, wildfire recovery, tourism demand, and broader Maui housing conditions.
